headline: Proposed change to Community Preservation Committee term limits and a Route 127 road safety audit.
summary: The General Counsel sent a memo proposing an amendment to Code of Ordinances Sec. 2-534. The Mayor sent a memo on a road safety audit for Route 127.
items: Proposed amendment to Code of Ordinances Sec. 2-534 on Community Preservation Committee term limits, from the General Counsel
Route 127 road safety audit, from the Mayor
